title: Choose the visual world (re-roll)
question: Re-roll assigned Build Log Console. Prior directions are out. Keep this, take an alternate, re-roll again, or take the category standard.

options.label: Build Log Console
options.lineage: make / ninja / cargo build logs with collapsible steps
options.thesis: The agent session is a live build: steps, spinners, errors, and blocked targets—approvals are the steps that won't compile until you say so.
options.viewport: Vertical Claude Code–like stack: dim completed steps, bright active step with spinner, expanded tool body with paths, a blocked APPROVE step mid-stream, prompt docked bottom, thin status with cwd/model.
options.risk: Can feel like CI noise if hierarchy fails and every tool line screams equally.

options.label: Telop Field
options.thesis: Attention is typeset: fat outlined captions for gates, quiet gray mutter for tool chatter, gone when the beat ends.
options.viewport: Dark stream; user/agent lines normal weight; tool noise small and gray; approval as a large yellow-outlined caption demanding y/n.
options.risk: TV-caption energy can undercut trust for a serious local coding tool.
options.case: Strong product clarity for signal vs noise; weaker engineer identification than a build-log world.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theater cyclorama lighting from black to day
options.thesis: Session phase is light: plan is pre-dawn, tools gather color, approval is the cue before full day.
options.viewport: Near-black terminal; a low cobalt status band; rose accent on active agent work; approval cue brightens the field before completion day-wash.
options.risk: Mood lighting can obscure scannable task state under rapid tool streams.
options.case: Poetic phase map for plan→run; loses operate scanability against build-step grammar.

options.label: Park Poster Inks
options.thesis: Four flat inks only: monumental mode words, unbroken color fields, zero gradient chrome.
options.viewport: Teal-dark field; block-cap PLAN / APPROVE / RUN as mode marks; cream body stream; gold only on the live gate.
options.risk: Poster monumentality fights dense multi-line tool and diff content.
options.case: Excellent palette discipline and mode clarity; weaker for continuous transcript density.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Claude Code / Aider craft: dark monochrome stream, restrained accent, inline tools, bottom prompt—at full fidelity.
canonCard.viewport: Vertical stack transcript, status chrome, prompt docked bottom, tool blocks and diffs inline—familiar agent-CLI arrangement.
canonCard.risk: Safe and correct; easier to ship, harder to own a distinct world.
